messages:
Alyssa: Quick prelaunch check — landing post + benchmark narrative going live next Tue. Need final decisions on: canonical URLs, redirect map for old beta pages, JSON-LD schema, and internal link hubs. Who can own?
Matt: I can take canonical + redirect map. Will pull the beta URLs and draft netlify/nginx examples.
Samir: I can own schema (FAQ/Product) and make sure markup matches our data layer. also will do a mini QA with structured data testing tool.
Emily: I can run the internal linking plan — identify top 5 pillar pages to link from the launch post and add anchor text guidance.
Alyssa: Awesome. Timeline: Matt by EOD today for redirects, Samir by tomorrow noon for schema, Emily by EOD tomorrow for internal links.
Matt: Draft redirect snippet (for Netlify _redirects):
```
/beta/*  /product/:splat  301!
/old-benchmark  /benchmarks/2026-launch  301
```
Matt: Will also export a full CSV of 301s and the reason column (legacy, merged content, tracked campaign).
Samir: JSON-LD plan: Product + Organization + FAQ. Example FAQ block I'll attach to the doc, but sample question/answer pair will follow schema.org/FAQPage. Will run through Search Console after publish.
Emily: Internal linking scorecard — I'll flag gaps where pillar pages have < 3 inbound site links and propose 2 opportunistic editorial links from blog + docs.
seo-bot: Reminder: run structured-data tester and URL inspection after deploy — use tag release/v1.2-launch for easier audit.
Alyssa: Two content notes: 1) Keep one canonical per topic (no index/alternate mixes). 2) Redirects should keep utm-free canonical targets.
Samir: Noted. For FAQ, ensure answers remain under 300 chars where possible to reduce SERP truncation.
Matt: Uploading redirect CSV to the doc now: https://docs.google.com/document/d/placeholder-redirects
Emily: I'll drop the internal link map in the same doc and add suggested anchor copy.
Alyssa: If anything risky (content split, conflicting canonical) ping #legal-marketing. Otherwise we'll merge changes into the release branch and schedule a soft publish for Tuesday 09:00 PT. :rocket:
Matt: Quick Q — any pages to intentionally 410 instead of 301? old support sandbox pages we want to remove.
Alyssa: Yes — sandbox demo pages that were temporary -> 410. I'll add a note in the doc.
Samir: After publish I'll queue a quick regression alert for impressions/drop via GA and Search Console.
Emily: ACK. I'll also add in-content CTAs linking to the sign-up funnel to capture traffic from pillar pages.
Alyssa: Perfect. Thanks team — I'll close the loop once redirects + schema + link map are in the doc. :raised_hands:
